notes: Key Operating Metrics FPR (Tables 5-6) reports % of revenue metrics across sales brackets for 134 qualifying outlets with P&L data. Gross Sales FPR (Tables 7-9) reports dollar figures for 202 qualifying outlets open 24+ months. Table 5 vs Table 6 show count discrepancy in middle brackets (Table 5: 58 outlets in $1M-$1.5M and 7 in $1.5M+; Table 6: 61 and 4 respectively — both sum to 134). Table 6(b) company-owned 'All Qualifying Outlets' lowest margin shown as 43.3% which is inconsistent with -39.4% in $0-$900K bracket — likely OCR/layout error. Net Operating Margin = Total Revenue less Prime Operating Costs (COGS+Wages+Occupancy) less Royalty & Marketing (9%) less Other Operating Costs; expressed as % of Total Revenue. Table 6 values represent per-outlet margin distributions; Table 5 values represent composite aggregate margins across all outlets in each bracket.
